lines_detail.speaker: LADY JULIANA
lines_detail.text: Why are you holding her hand?

lines_detail.speaker: LADY JULIANA
lines_detail.text: You knew this before I walked through those doors!

lines_detail.speaker: LADY JULIANA
lines_detail.text: You let me dress in my mother's gown...

lines_detail.speaker: LADY JULIANA
lines_detail.text: You let me believe I was walking toward my husband!

lines_detail.speaker: LADY IN GOLD GOWN
lines_detail.text: Long enough to know he was never going to marry you.

lines_detail.speaker: LADY JULIANA
lines_detail.text: Tell them this is a mistake.

lines_detail.speaker: MATRIARCH
lines_detail.text: You have embarrassed this family long enough.

lines_detail.speaker: MATRIARCH
lines_detail.text: Clarissa knows how to carry herself.

lines_detail.speaker: MATRIARCH
lines_detail.text: She has beauty, connections, and a future worth protecting.

lines_detail.speaker: LADY IN GOLD GOWN
lines_detail.text: You are the daughter people tolerate because they have to.

lines_detail.speaker: LADY IN GOLD GOWN
lines_detail.text: I am the daughter they choose.

lines_detail.speaker: MATRIARCH
lines_detail.text: Clarissa is the jewel of this family.

lines_detail.speaker: LADY JULIANA
lines_detail.text: So that is what I was worth to you?

lines_detail.speaker: THE FORMER GROOM
lines_detail.text: You have nothing to offer me anymore.

lines_detail.speaker: THE FORMER GROOM
lines_detail.text: I cannot marry a woman of such plainness and low value...

lines_detail.speaker: THE FORMER GROOM
lines_detail.text: ...when Clarissa is the true jewel of the county.

lines_detail.speaker: THE FORMER GROOM
lines_detail.text: ...and completely beneath the future I deserve.

lines_detail.speaker: LADY JULIANA
lines_detail.text: You gave me your word before both our families.

lines_detail.speaker: THE FORMER GROOM
lines_detail.text: Promises change when a better choice appears.

lines_detail.speaker: LADY JULIANA
lines_detail.text: A better choice? Is that what she is?

lines_detail.speaker: THE FORMER GROOM
lines_detail.text: She is what I should have chosen from the beginning.

lines_detail.speaker: LADY JULIANA
lines_detail.text: Surely you will not let him humiliate me like this?

lines_detail.speaker: BLOND NOBLEMAN
lines_detail.text: Gerald has made his choice. Accept it, Juliana.

lines_detail.speaker: LADY JULIANA
lines_detail.text: You won't even look at me.

lines_detail.speaker: LADY IN GOLD GOWN
lines_detail.text: Why are you surprised, sister? Look at you.

lines_detail.speaker: LADY IN GOLD GOWN
lines_detail.text: You look like a kitchen maid who wandered into the wrong wedding.

lines_detail.speaker: LADY IN GOLD GOWN
lines_detail.text: ...not a dull creature who hides in her mother's apothecary herbs.

lines_detail.speaker: OFF-SCREEN VOICE
lines_detail.text: Oh, don't look so wounded, Juliana.

lines_detail.speaker: OFF-SCREEN VOICE
lines_detail.text: You should be grateful you're at least allowed to attend the wedding.

lines_detail.speaker: THE FORMER GROOM
lines_detail.text: Go home quietly, Juliana. At least leave this chapel with some dignity.

lines_detail.speaker: LADY JULIANA
lines_detail.text: You abandoned a woman who trusted you...

lines_detail.speaker: LADY JULIANA
lines_detail.text: ...because another woman promised you greater beauty and wealth.

lines_detail.speaker: LADY JULIANA
lines_detail.text: Do not mistake my heartbreak for your victory, Gerald.

lines_detail.speaker: LADY JULIANA
lines_detail.text: You wanted this entire chapel to believe that I was not worthy of you. But you have shown them something far more valuable.

lines_detail.speaker: LADY JULIANA
lines_detail.text: You have shown them exactly what your word is worth.

lines_detail.speaker: LADY JULIANA
lines_detail.text: I may leave this chapel without a husband...

lines_detail.speaker: LADY JULIANA
lines_detail.text: ...but I will not leave it believing I was the one who should be ashamed.

lines_detail.speaker: LADY IN GOLD GOWN
lines_detail.text: ...still clinging to that little locket as if it can make you worthy of a place here.

lines_detail.speaker: LADY IN GOLD GOWN
lines_detail.text: I didn't steal what was never truly yours.

lines_detail.speaker: NOBLE MATRIARCH
lines_detail.text: You have humiliated this family enough for one day.

lines_detail.speaker: LADY JULIANA
lines_detail.text: I was humiliated by your family.

lines_detail.speaker: NOBLE MATRIARCH
lines_detail.text: Your father has made his choice.

lines_detail.speaker: LADY JULIANA
lines_detail.text: I have every right to stand here.

lines_detail.speaker: NOBLE MATRIARCH
lines_detail.text: Your father has chosen his family...

lines_detail.speaker: NOBLE MATRIARCH
lines_detail.text: And who are you to give orders in my family's chapel?!

lines_detail.speaker: THE FORMER GROOM
lines_detail.text: What are you waiting for?! He's only one man!

lines_detail.speaker: THE BEARDED STRANGER
lines_detail.text: Good. Then don't touch her again.

lines_detail.speaker: NOBLE MATRIARCH
lines_detail.text: You cannot interfere in a family matter!

lines_detail.speaker: THE BEARDED STRANGER
lines_detail.text: ...when your family is dragging a defenseless woman from a church.

lines_detail.speaker: THE BEARDED STRANGER
lines_detail.text: You shouldn't have to beg anybody...

lines_detail.speaker: THE BEARDED STRANGER
lines_detail.text: You came here to become a wife.

lines_detail.speaker: GERALD
lines_detail.text: A penniless nobody for a discarded bride.

lines_detail.speaker: CLARISSA
lines_detail.text: You have finally found a man as worthless as everyone thinks you are.

lines_detail.speaker: JULIANA
lines_detail.text: You heard what they think I am.

lines_detail.speaker: JULIANA
lines_detail.text: Why would you offer me your name?

lines_detail.speaker: MYSTERIOUS BEARDED MAN
lines_detail.text: Because I know what I see.

lines_detail.speaker: MYSTERIOUS BEARDED MAN
lines_detail.text: Not a woman who deserves to be discarded.

lines_detail.speaker: JULIANA
lines_detail.text: You don't know what my family has done to me.

lines_detail.speaker: MYSTERIOUS BEARDED MAN
lines_detail.text: I know they have made you stand alone.

lines_detail.speaker: MYSTERIOUS BEARDED MAN
lines_detail.text: You don't have to stand alone now.

lines_detail.speaker: JULIANA
lines_detail.text: If this is pity, take back your ring.

lines_detail.speaker: JULIANA
lines_detail.text: I will not become anyone's charity.

lines_detail.speaker: MYSTERIOUS BEARDED MAN
lines_detail.text: It is not pity, Lady Juliana.

lines_detail.speaker: JULIANA
lines_detail.text: I don't know what waits beyond these doors.

lines_detail.speaker: JULIANA
lines_detail.text: But he looked at me when everyone else turned away.

lines_detail.speaker: MYSTERIOUS BEARDED MAN
lines_detail.text: You need not say anything you do not mean.

lines_detail.speaker: THE PRIEST
lines_detail.text: By the authority entrusted to me, I now pronounce you...

lines_detail.speaker: JULIANA
lines_detail.text: I would rather choose my own life...

lines_detail.speaker: JULIANA
lines_detail.text: ...than spend another moment begging for yours.

lines_detail.speaker: LADY ASHCROFT
lines_detail.text: Do not bring this man anywhere near Ashcroft Manor!

lines_detail.speaker: LORD ASHCROFT
lines_detail.text: You will not leave this church carrying the Ashcroft name.

lines_detail.speaker: JULIANA
lines_detail.text: The vows are spoken, Father. I am his wife now.

lines_detail.speaker: LORD ASHCROFT
lines_detail.text: You leave as no daughter of mine.

lines_detail.speaker: LORD ASHCROFT
lines_detail.text: From this moment, you are dead to the Ashcroft family.

lines_detail.speaker: JULIANA
lines_detail.text: You truly mean it? You are my father!

lines_detail.speaker: LORD ASHCROFT
lines_detail.text: And you have chosen to become a stranger.

lines_detail.speaker: JULIANA
lines_detail.text: No, Father. You chose that long before today.

lines_detail.speaker: JULIANA
lines_detail.text: It belonged to my mother! It is all I have left of her.

lines_detail.speaker: LADY ASHCROFT
lines_detail.text: Then you should have guarded it better.

lines_detail.speaker: CLARISSA
lines_detail.text: Even your mother's precious legacy has been cast into the dirt!

lines_detail.speaker: GERALD
lines_detail.text: Perhaps that is where it belongs.

lines_detail.speaker: MYSTERIOUS BEARDED MAN
lines_detail.text: They dirtied it. That is not the same thing.

lines_detail.speaker: GERALD
lines_detail.text: A noblewoman reduced to a beggar's wife!

lines_detail.speaker: MYSTERIOUS BEARDED MAN
lines_detail.text: I know this is not the life you came from.

lines_detail.speaker: MYSTERIOUS BEARDED MAN
lines_detail.text: You should not have had to walk through this rain tonight.

lines_detail.speaker: JULIANA
lines_detail.text: I suppose the day was already ruined.

lines_detail.speaker: JULIANA
lines_detail.text: At least no one there will be waiting to humiliate me.

lines_detail.speaker: MYSTERIOUS BEARDED MAN
lines_detail.text: This is all I can give you now.

lines_detail.speaker: JULIANA
lines_detail.text: If this is our home, I want it clean.

lines_detail.speaker: MYSTERIOUS BEARDED MAN
lines_detail.text: You don't have to do that tonight.

lines_detail.speaker: JULIANA
lines_detail.text: If I stop now, I will think about everything I lost.

lines_detail.speaker: JULIANA
lines_detail.text: Everything I thought my life would be.

lines_detail.speaker: JULIANA
lines_detail.text: Sitting here with him, I don't feel afraid.

lines_detail.speaker: ARISTOCRATIC WOMAN
lines_detail.text: This is where you live now?

lines_detail.speaker: GERALD
lines_detail.text: A fitting home for a woman who threw away everything for a penniless soldier.

lines_detail.speaker: JULIANA
lines_detail.text: You came all this way just to insult my home?

lines_detail.speaker: ARISTOCRATIC WOMAN
lines_detail.text: Home? Look at your hands, Juliana.

lines_detail.speaker: JULIANA
lines_detail.text: I work with my hands. There is no shame in that.

lines_detail.speaker: GERALD
lines_detail.text: You chose that scarred beggar over a life of comfort.

lines_detail.speaker: JULIANA
lines_detail.text: I chose a man who stood beside me when you walked away.

lines_detail.speaker: JULIANA
lines_detail.text: You have no authority here. Leave.

lines_detail.speaker: GERALD
lines_detail.text: I have enough influence to make a beggar disappear.

lines_detail.speaker: ARISTOCRATIC WOMAN
lines_detail.text: Gerald, don't let him frighten you.

lines_detail.speaker: JULIANA
lines_detail.text: Some of the pages are ruined. Careful.

lines_detail.speaker: ALEXANDER
lines_detail.text: Soldiers learn quickly which plants keep a man alive.

lines_detail.speaker: JULIANA
lines_detail.text: You know more about healing than you let on.

lines_detail.speaker: JULIANA
lines_detail.text: I could trim them for you.

lines_detail.speaker: JULIANA
lines_detail.text: You prefer looking like a forest hermit?

lines_detail.speaker: JULIANA
lines_detail.text: But one day, I am trimming that beard.

lines_detail.speaker: ALEXANDER
lines_detail.text: That one grows near the northern stream. Crushed leaves ease swelling.

lines_detail.speaker: JULIANA
lines_detail.text: My mother wrote the same thing.

lines_detail.speaker: JULIANA
lines_detail.text: And the scars... were they from the war?

lines_detail.speaker: JULIANA
lines_detail.text: I thought losing wealth meant losing everything.

lines_detail.speaker: PEASANT MOTHER
lines_detail.text: Please! They told me there was a woman here who knows herbs. My boy is burning with fever!

lines_detail.speaker: JULIANA
lines_detail.text: He seems very unwell, but he is resting steadily. How long has he been like this?

lines_detail.speaker: PEASANT MOTHER
lines_detail.text: Since yesterday morning. He has barely eaten since sunset.

lines_detail.speaker: JULIANA
lines_detail.text: The herbs did their work. Let him rest.

lines_detail.speaker: PEASANT MOTHER
lines_detail.text: I will tell the village what you did. They will never forget you.

lines_detail.speaker: ALEXANDER
lines_detail.text: You cannot let the whole village start talking about you.

lines_detail.speaker: JULIANA
lines_detail.text: A child's life matters more than gossip.

lines_detail.speaker: ALEXANDER
lines_detail.text: Gossip has a way of becoming dangerous.

lines_detail.speaker: JULIANA
lines_detail.text: Then we will face it together.

lines_detail.speaker: THE FORMER GROOM
lines_detail.text: There is a rumor going around, my Lord.

lines_detail.speaker: THE FORMER GROOM
lines_detail.text: About a war veteran. Some say he resembles the late Duke.

lines_detail.speaker: BLOND NOBLEMAN
lines_detail.text: People see ghosts whenever they want a story.

lines_detail.speaker: THE FORMER GROOM
lines_detail.text: The man is said to have the same kind of scar the Duke carried after the war.

lines_detail.speaker: BLOND NOBLEMAN
lines_detail.text: Then let it remain a rumor.

lines_detail.speaker: JULIANA
lines_detail.text: There is blood running down your arm.

lines_detail.speaker: ALEXANDER
lines_detail.text: A cut from the tenant fields.

lines_detail.speaker: JULIANA
lines_detail.text: I need to see the wound.

lines_detail.speaker: JULIANA
lines_detail.text: Then removing your shirt should not trouble you.

lines_detail.speaker: JULIANA
lines_detail.text: Why do you look at me like that?

lines_detail.speaker: ALEXANDER
lines_detail.text: Because you are looking at me.

lines_detail.speaker: ALEXANDER
lines_detail.text: Your touch is the only medicine that has ever eased my pain.

lines_detail.speaker: JULIANA
lines_detail.text: Gerald? What are you doing here?

lines_detail.speaker: GERALD
lines_detail.text: I came for something that belongs to me.

lines_detail.speaker: JULIANA
lines_detail.text: You have already taken enough from me. Leave!

lines_detail.speaker: GERALD
lines_detail.text: Your husband stole my gold pocket watch!

lines_detail.speaker: GERALD
lines_detail.text: The last time I came here.

lines_detail.speaker: JULIANA
lines_detail.text: You never even entered the cottage!

lines_detail.speaker: GERALD
lines_detail.text: Then you should have nothing to fear from a search.

lines_detail.speaker: JULIANA
lines_detail.text: Alexander would never steal from you.

lines_detail.speaker: GERALD
lines_detail.text: Of course you would defend him. You married a beggar!

lines_detail.speaker: GERALD
lines_detail.text: You hear that? He threatens me again!

lines_detail.speaker: CONSTABLE
lines_detail.text: I have received a complaint of theft.

lines_detail.speaker: CONSTABLE
lines_detail.text: Then a search will settle the matter.

lines_detail.speaker: JULIANA
lines_detail.text: You cannot simply invade our home because this man makes an accusation!

lines_detail.speaker: GERALD
lines_detail.text: If he has nothing to hide...

lines_detail.speaker: JULIANA
lines_detail.text: Stop! Those are my mother's medicines!

lines_detail.speaker: CONSTABLE
lines_detail.text: Then you have nothing to fear.

lines_detail.speaker: JULIANA
lines_detail.text: Those are all I have left!

lines_detail.speaker: GERALD
lines_detail.text: Stand aside. Look at this place. A perfect hiding hole for a thief.

lines_detail.speaker: JULIANA
lines_detail.text: You planted this accusation because you cannot bear that I am happy without you!

lines_detail.speaker: GERALD
lines_detail.text: What is it, soldier? Going to strike a gentleman in front of his wife?

lines_detail.speaker: ALEXANDER
lines_detail.text: But one blow would destroy her life.

lines_detail.speaker: CONSTABLE
lines_detail.text: Put out your hands, veteran. You are under arrest for theft.

lines_detail.speaker: JULIANA
lines_detail.text: No! That watch was not in his coat!

lines_detail.speaker: GERALD
lines_detail.text: The proof is in his coat, Juliana. A valuable pocket watch doesn't just walk into a beggar's pocket.

lines_detail.speaker: ALEXANDER
lines_detail.text: I have never touched your property.

lines_detail.speaker: GERALD
lines_detail.text: Then perhaps your wife should explain why it was found in your coat.

lines_detail.speaker: CLARISSA
lines_detail.text: ...still defending your broken scrap of a man?

lines_detail.speaker: JULIANA
lines_detail.text: Name your price, Clarissa. I know you.

lines_detail.speaker: CLARISSA
lines_detail.text: You always were clever, Juliana. Always searching for some way to escape.

lines_detail.speaker: CLARISSA
lines_detail.text: Perhaps I can give you one.

lines_detail.speaker: CLARISSA
lines_detail.text: I want to see you crawl, sister.

lines_detail.speaker: CLARISSA
lines_detail.text: My emerald signet ring fell deep into the frozen blackthorn briars at Ashworth Manor. The thorns have grown over it...

lines_detail.speaker: CLARISSA
lines_detail.text: ...sharp as steel. The ground is frozen, like pure ice.

lines_detail.speaker: CLARISSA
lines_detail.text: You will retrieve it with your bare hands before the magistrate arrives.

lines_detail.speaker: GERALD
lines_detail.text: A lady's hands will be shredded to ribbons!

lines_detail.speaker: CLARISSA
lines_detail.text: Do it, and we withdraw the charges.

lines_detail.speaker: CLARISSA
lines_detail.text: Fail, or refuse, and your husband hangs from the gallows.

lines_detail.speaker: ALEXANDER
lines_detail.text: Juliana, no. Do not let them hurt you. I can handle the law.

lines_detail.speaker: JULIANA
lines_detail.text: I am not letting them take you.

lines_detail.speaker: JULIANA
lines_detail.text: Tell me where the garden is.

lines_detail.speaker: ALEXANDER
lines_detail.text: Juliana, look at those thorns. You cannot do this.

lines_detail.speaker: ALEXANDER
lines_detail.text: They will tear your hands apart.

lines_detail.speaker: ALEXANDER
lines_detail.text: I would rather face the gallows than watch you hurt yourself for me.

lines_detail.speaker: JULIANA
lines_detail.text: You stood beside me when everyone else abandoned me. I will not abandon you now.

lines_detail.speaker: CLARISSA
lines_detail.text: That garden has swallowed better women than you.

lines_detail.speaker: GERALD
lines_detail.text: Perhaps the beggar's wife will finally learn what her new life is worth.

lines_detail.speaker: CLARISSA
lines_detail.text: The lady has finally found something worthy of her.

lines_detail.speaker: GERALD
lines_detail.text: Keep searching, Juliana. Your husband's freedom is somewhere in that garden.

lines_detail.speaker: JULIANA
lines_detail.text: Please, ring... you have to be here.

lines_detail.speaker: ALEXANDER
lines_detail.text: What have they done to you?

lines_detail.speaker: ALEXANDER
lines_detail.text: You should never have had to bleed for me.

lines_detail.speaker: ALEXANDER
lines_detail.text: You could have lost your hands.

lines_detail.speaker: JULIANA
lines_detail.text: You have taken my place today.

lines_detail.speaker: JULIANA
lines_detail.text: And you are doing it better than me.

lines_detail.speaker: ALEXANDER
lines_detail.text: No one will ever hurt you for protecting me again.

lines_detail.speaker: BALD THUG
lines_detail.text: They look like weeds to me.

lines_detail.speaker: JULIANA
lines_detail.text: Please! Those plants took months to grow!

lines_detail.speaker: TALL THUG
lines_detail.text: Months? You actually spend your days growing this filth?

lines_detail.speaker: THUG WITH CAP
lines_detail.text: A noble lady playing in the dirt. What a joke.

lines_detail.speaker: JULIANA
lines_detail.text: It is my home. You have no right to destroy anything here.

lines_detail.speaker: BALD THUG
lines_detail.text: Look at her! Crying over weeds!

lines_detail.speaker: THUG WITH CAP
lines_detail.text: What? You want to fight us, veteran?

lines_detail.speaker: THUG WITH CAP
lines_detail.text: We were only paid to destroy the garden, that's all!

lines_detail.speaker: JULIANA
lines_detail.text: You knew exactly what to do.

lines_detail.speaker: JULIANA
lines_detail.text: You fought like you've done this a hundred times.

lines_detail.speaker: ALEXANDER
lines_detail.text: A soldier learns things he wishes he could forget.

lines_detail.speaker: JULIANA
lines_detail.text: For standing between me and those men.

lines_detail.speaker: JULIANA
lines_detail.text: Even if there were ten of them?

lines_detail.speaker: ALEXANDER
lines_detail.text: As long as I draw breath...

lines_detail.speaker: JULIANA
lines_detail.text: You make it very difficult to argue with you.

lines_detail.speaker: JULIANA
lines_detail.text: Soon birds will start nesting in it.

lines_detail.speaker: JULIANA
lines_detail.text: Then I shall have to save you from the birds.

lines_detail.speaker: JULIANA
lines_detail.text: I know almost nothing about the man I married.

lines_detail.speaker: JULIANA
lines_detail.text: But every day, he gives me another reason to trust him.

lines_detail.speaker: ALEXANDER
lines_detail.text: Juliana, the ceiling is coming down!

lines_detail.speaker: ALEXANDER
lines_detail.text: They took our home. I will not let them take anything else now.

lines_detail.speaker: JULIANA
lines_detail.text: What are you going to do?

lines_detail.speaker: JULIANA
lines_detail.text: My mother's book almost burned with it.

lines_detail.speaker: ELDER VILLAGER
lines_detail.text: My lady. You cannot stay here.

lines_detail.speaker: ELDER VILLAGER
lines_detail.text: There is an old barn near the village. It is empty.

lines_detail.speaker: JULIANA
lines_detail.text: We cannot ask the village to feed us.

lines_detail.speaker: ALEXANDER
lines_detail.text: We will not forget this kindness.

lines_detail.speaker: ALEXANDER
lines_detail.text: Tell me what is happening in Ashburg.

lines_detail.speaker: INFORMANT
lines_detail.text: Lord Sterling's influence has grown since your disappearance. He has men in the county offices, the courts, even among the household staff.

lines_detail.speaker: INFORMANT
lines_detail.text: Rupert has become the face of Ashburg. He sits in your father's room, signs your estate papers, gives orders as though the title already belongs to him.

lines_detail.speaker: INFORMANT
lines_detail.text: And Lady Catherine, she behaves as though she is already the future duchess.

lines_detail.speaker: INFORMANT
lines_detail.text: But they have separated her from the household. She is watched constantly. Every letter she sends is checked. Every visitor is questioned.

lines_detail.speaker: INFORMANT
lines_detail.text: There are almost no loyal servants left around her.

lines_detail.speaker: INFORMANT
lines_detail.text: The people who served your family for years have been dismissed, frightened away, or replaced.

lines_detail.speaker: ALEXANDER
lines_detail.text: My mother is a prisoner in her own house.

lines_detail.speaker: INFORMANT
lines_detail.text: And everyone believes you are dead.

lines_detail.speaker: ALEXANDER
lines_detail.text: Then let them believe it a little longer.

lines_detail.speaker: INFORMANT
lines_detail.text: And when we have the proof?

lines_detail.speaker: ALEXANDER
lines_detail.text: Then Ashburg will remember who it belongs to.

lines_detail.speaker: JULIANA
lines_detail.text: I don't know what we will do tomorrow.

lines_detail.speaker: JULIANA
lines_detail.text: You make it sound so simple.

lines_detail.speaker: CATHERINE
lines_detail.text: Or has your sudden climb to power sweetened your taste already?

lines_detail.speaker: RUPERT
lines_detail.text: Only if it sweetens your disposition, Catherine.

lines_detail.speaker: RUPERT
lines_detail.text: The succession papers are being finalized as we speak.

lines_detail.speaker: CATHERINE
lines_detail.text: 'Practically' is a word for beggars. I do not marry a practical Duke.

lines_detail.speaker: CATHERINE
lines_detail.text: I marry the Lord of Ashbury.

lines_detail.speaker: RUPERT
lines_detail.text: Once my cousin Alexander's death is formally sealed by the Crown...

lines_detail.speaker: CATHERINE
lines_detail.text: And what of the Dowager? The old woman still breathes.

lines_detail.speaker: CATHERINE
lines_detail.text: Her shadow still hangs over this house.

lines_detail.speaker: RUPERT
lines_detail.text: Her health fails more each day. The physicians are baffled.

lines_detail.speaker: RUPERT
lines_detail.text: They call it a wasting of the lungs.

lines_detail.speaker: CATHERINE
lines_detail.text: How tragic. The slow, quiet decline.

lines_detail.speaker: CATHERINE
lines_detail.text: How much longer can the frail thing survive?

lines_detail.speaker: RUPERT
lines_detail.text: Not through the winter. I've ensured her quiet comfort.

lines_detail.speaker: CATHERINE
lines_detail.text: Good. The village is already whispering about her.

lines_detail.speaker: CATHERINE
lines_detail.text: The local peasants are like dogs, barking at every carriage that passes.

lines_detail.speaker: RUPERT
lines_detail.text: They are nothing. Dirt beneath our boots.

lines_detail.speaker: RUPERT
lines_detail.text: They will learn their place when you wear the ducal crown.

lines_detail.speaker: SEAMUS
lines_detail.text: Let me take that basket, Lady Juliana.

lines_detail.speaker: SEAMUS
lines_detail.text: Your palms are still raw from the fire. You shouldn't be working in this freezing draft.

lines_detail.speaker: JULIANA
lines_detail.text: If I stop, Seamus, the lung fever in the valley wins.

lines_detail.speaker: JULIANA
lines_detail.text: I do not yield to a cold draft.

lines_detail.speaker: SEAMUS
lines_detail.text: Let the village tend to itself for once!

lines_detail.speaker: JULIANA
lines_detail.text: The chapel is gone, Seamus. I am the only healer these people have left.

lines_detail.speaker: SEAMUS
lines_detail.text: They have reduced you to a peasant.

lines_detail.speaker: JULIANA
lines_detail.text: They have reduced me to myself.

lines_detail.speaker: CATHERINE
lines_detail.text: Let the peasants rot in their barns.

lines_detail.speaker: CATHERINE
lines_detail.text: Let them pray to their weeds.

lines_detail.speaker: RUPERT
lines_detail.text: You have no rival here, Catherine.

lines_detail.speaker: RUPERT
lines_detail.text: No one to stand in your way.

lines_detail.speaker: CATHERINE
lines_detail.text: Once the old Duchess is gone...

lines_detail.speaker: CATHERINE
lines_detail.text: This house will only bow to me.

lines_detail.speaker: PRUDENCE
lines_detail.text: Lady Juliana! Please! You have to help me, Toby is dying!

lines_detail.speaker: LADY JULIANA
lines_detail.text: Oh dear. Breathe. Tell me what has happened.

lines_detail.speaker: PRUDENCE
lines_detail.text: My little brother Toby... his chest is burning! He cannot breathe!

lines_detail.speaker: LADY JULIANA
lines_detail.text: Tell me what the apothecary said. Did he not give you medicine?

lines_detail.speaker: PRUDENCE
lines_detail.text: He shut the door in my face because we have no silver!

lines_detail.speaker: PRUDENCE
lines_detail.text: The manor doctor laughed! He said village boys are not worth his time!

lines_detail.speaker: LADY JULIANA
lines_detail.text: Our cottage is ashes. I have nothing left but this coltsfoot.

lines_detail.speaker: PRUDENCE
lines_detail.text: He is only seven! If you do not come, he will die! You are his only hope, Lady Juliana!

lines_detail.speaker: LADY JULIANA
lines_detail.text: Stand up. Sinking to your knees will not save him. Let me grab my ledger. We go now.

lines_detail.speaker: PRUDENCE
lines_detail.text: Yes! Right away, I will get it!

lines_detail.speaker: LADY JULIANA
lines_detail.text: I cannot let my own weariness stop me. This boy needs my mother's knowledge.

lines_detail.speaker: LADY JULIANA
lines_detail.text: Lift his shoulders, Prudence. Hold the steam close. Let him inhale.

lines_detail.speaker: PRUDENCE
lines_detail.text: Like this? Toby, breathe it in, sweet boy.

lines_detail.speaker: LADY JULIANA
lines_detail.text: Yes, just like that. Keep breathing, Toby. Let the vapor clear your chest.

lines_detail.speaker: PRUDENCE
lines_detail.text: Oh, thank God! His chest is quiet! The rattling has stopped!

lines_detail.speaker: LADY JULIANA
lines_detail.text: Keep him warm. Give him three drops of this coltsfoot tea every morning.

lines_detail.speaker: PRUDENCE
lines_detail.text: You saved him. The grand doctors left him to choke, but you...

lines_detail.speaker: PRUDENCE
lines_detail.text: I have no money, Lady Juliana, but I swear on my life, I will do anything to repay you.

lines_detail.speaker: LADY JULIANA
lines_detail.text: Your brother's breath is payment enough for me, Prudence.

lines_detail.speaker: PRUDENCE
lines_detail.text: At the grand manor, they ignore us. They only care about their own luxury.

lines_detail.speaker: PRUDENCE
lines_detail.text: But their gold cannot buy them health.

lines_detail.speaker: LADY JULIANA
lines_detail.text: What do you mean? Is someone ill? The Dowager Duchess?

lines_detail.speaker: PRUDENCE
lines_detail.text: A strange, mysterious illness is eating her away.

lines_detail.speaker: PRUDENCE
lines_detail.text: Inside that massive house with all their wealth, she is fading to nothing, and no one can stop it.

lines_detail.speaker: PRUDENCE
lines_detail.text: Keep your head down. If anyone recognizes you, everything is over.

lines_detail.speaker: LADY JULIANA
lines_detail.text: No one will recognize me dressed like this.

lines_detail.speaker: PRUDENCE
lines_detail.text: This is Ashburton Manor. The housekeeper watches everyone. Lady Catherine watches everyone, and Lord Rupert...

lines_detail.speaker: LADY JULIANA
lines_detail.text: I saved Toby. I can save her.

lines_detail.speaker: PRUDENCE
lines_detail.text: And if they discover who you are?

lines_detail.speaker: LADY JULIANA
lines_detail.text: Then I will face that when she is breathing again.

lines_detail.speaker: PRUDENCE
lines_detail.text: Then forget you were ever a lady.

lines_detail.speaker: LADY JULIANA
lines_detail.text: Today, I am only a maid.

lines_detail.speaker: PRUDENCE
lines_detail.text: Julian, ma'am. New help for the winter cleaning.

lines_detail.speaker: HOUSEKEEPER
lines_detail.text: And can you keep your eyes and ears where they belong?

lines_detail.speaker: HOUSEKEEPER
lines_detail.text: Then prove it. The manor has no use for useless girls.

lines_detail.speaker: PRUDENCE
lines_detail.text: Beyond the grand staircase. Few servants go there.

lines_detail.speaker: PRUDENCE
lines_detail.text: Juliana, we cannot stay for long. Someone will come.

lines_detail.speaker: LADY JULIANA
lines_detail.text: How long has she been like this?

lines_detail.speaker: PRUDENCE
lines_detail.text: The physician said her heart is failing.

lines_detail.speaker: LADY JULIANA
lines_detail.text: This is not simply old age.

lines_detail.speaker: LADY JULIANA
lines_detail.text: Weakness. Dry mouth. The discoloration beneath the nails. The slow wasting.

lines_detail.speaker: LADY JULIANA
lines_detail.text: I have seen these symptoms before.

lines_detail.speaker: LADY JULIANA
lines_detail.text: The charcoal may help remove what is still inside her. We must act quickly.

lines_detail.speaker: LADY JULIANA
lines_detail.text: Juliana, my lady. I was hired for the winter cleaning.

lines_detail.speaker: NOBLEWOMAN
lines_detail.text: And who gave you permission to enter this chamber?

lines_detail.speaker: LADY JULIANA
lines_detail.text: I heard her. I thought Her Grace needed help.

lines_detail.speaker: NOBLEWOMAN
lines_detail.text: You thought? A new maid thinks she knows better than the physicians?

lines_detail.speaker: NOBLEWOMAN
lines_detail.text: Not a physician. Not a lady.

lines_detail.speaker: NOBLEWOMAN
lines_detail.text: And certainly not a woman whose opinion matters.

lines_detail.speaker: NOBLEWOMAN
lines_detail.text: Good. Perhaps we can teach you your place.

lines_detail.speaker: NOBLEWOMAN
lines_detail.text: Every stone. Perhaps when your hands are black enough, you will finally remember what you are.

lines_detail.speaker: NOBLEWOMAN
lines_detail.text: Do you want the same punishment?

lines_detail.speaker: NOBLEWOMAN
lines_detail.text: That is where clever little servants belong.

lines_detail.speaker: LADY JULIANA
lines_detail.text: Let her think I am only a maid.

lines_detail.speaker: LADY JULIANA
lines_detail.text: Let her believe I am ignorant.

lines_detail.speaker: LADY JULIANA
lines_detail.text: I will return. You cannot stop the healer.

lines_detail.speaker: ALEXANDER
lines_detail.text: Why are you walking like that?

lines_detail.speaker: JULIANA
lines_detail.text: I am tired. That is all.

lines_detail.speaker: JULIANA
lines_detail.text: I was in the wrong chamber. I was punished as a maid.

lines_detail.speaker: ALEXANDER
lines_detail.text: Juliana... why were you inside Ashburg Manor?

lines_detail.speaker: JULIANA
lines_detail.text: I went there to help someone.

lines_detail.speaker: JULIANA
lines_detail.text: Prudence told me she was dying.

lines_detail.speaker: JULIANA
lines_detail.text: She was barely breathing when I found her. The doctor said she was simply growing old.

lines_detail.speaker: JULIANA
lines_detail.text: Someone has been giving it to her again and again. Small amounts. Enough to make her weaker without killing her quickly.

lines_detail.speaker: JULIANA
lines_detail.text: I made her medicine. She was still barely conscious, but her breathing became easier.

lines_detail.speaker: ALEXANDER
lines_detail.text: Will you be going there again?

lines_detail.speaker: JULIANA
lines_detail.text: She is still sick. I cannot leave her there.

lines_detail.speaker: JULIANA
lines_detail.text: Alexander... why are you so angry?

lines_detail.speaker: ALEXANDER
lines_detail.text: Because you were standing inside a house where someone is poisoning a woman... and you never told me.

lines_detail.speaker: ALEXANDER
lines_detail.text: Worry? They struck you. They could have killed you.

lines_detail.speaker: DOWAGER DUCHESS
lines_detail.text: Who are you? Speak to me. I have not seen your face before.

lines_detail.speaker: JULIANA
lines_detail.text: Please, Your Grace. Drink the last of this antidote. Drink it slowly.

lines_detail.speaker: DOWAGER DUCHESS
lines_detail.text: You... you are no common servant. You took Catherine's whip for me the other day.

lines_detail.speaker: JULIANA
lines_detail.text: I did what I had to. It does not change my duty.

lines_detail.speaker: JULIANA
lines_detail.text: Rest now, Your Grace. You are safe tonight.

lines_detail.speaker: JULIANA
lines_detail.text: If the guards hear us, we are both dead.

lines_detail.speaker: DOWAGER DUCHESS
lines_detail.text: Rupert and Catherine want me dead. They are poisoning me in my own bed, aren't they?

lines_detail.speaker: JULIANA
lines_detail.text: Yes. But the charcoal is fighting the poison. You are safe now.

lines_detail.speaker: DOWAGER DUCHESS
lines_detail.text: Then tell me... why is a girl of such noble spirit working as a common maid?

lines_detail.speaker: JULIANA
lines_detail.text: Because my family cast me out to rot. I have nothing left in this world but my honor.

lines_detail.speaker: DOWAGER DUCHESS
lines_detail.text: Your hand... Let me see your hand.

lines_detail.speaker: JULIANA
lines_detail.text: Your Grace? What is wrong? You look as though you've seen a ghost.

lines_detail.speaker: DOWAGER DUCHESS
lines_detail.text: Where... where... Where did you get this ring? Speak to me!

lines_detail.speaker: DOWAGER DUCHESS
lines_detail.text: Look at me, girl. Who gave this to you?

lines_detail.speaker: JULIANA
lines_detail.text: My husband. He gave it to me when we wed.

lines_detail.speaker: DOWAGER DUCHESS
lines_detail.text: He is no commoner. What does he do?

lines_detail.speaker: JULIANA
lines_detail.text: He is a soldier. A veteran from the Peninsula.

lines_detail.speaker: DOWAGER DUCHESS
lines_detail.text: That is no ordinary band. It bears the Ashbourne crest.

lines_detail.speaker: JULIANA
lines_detail.text: No. He lives in a barn. He has nothing but his word.

lines_detail.speaker: DOWAGER DUCHESS
lines_detail.text: My lost son wore that exact ring. He went to war...

lines_detail.speaker: JULIANA
lines_detail.text: Your son? He told me he was only a sergeant.

lines_detail.speaker: DOWAGER DUCHESS
lines_detail.text: My lost son wore that ring!

lines_detail.speaker: DOWAGER DUCHESS
lines_detail.text: Did your husband serve beside him?

lines_detail.speaker: JULIANA
lines_detail.text: He never spoke of his officers. He only spoke of survival.

lines_detail.speaker: LADY CATHERINE
lines_detail.text: What is that maid doing in Her Grace's private chamber?

lines_detail.speaker: BLOND NOBLEMAN
lines_detail.text: Girl. Show me what you are holding.

lines_detail.speaker: LADY CATHERINE
lines_detail.text: Medicine? You are a new maid.

lines_detail.speaker: LADY CATHERINE
lines_detail.text: Who permitted you to give medicine to the Duchess?

lines_detail.speaker: LADY CATHERINE
lines_detail.text: Then you administered it without permission.

lines_detail.speaker: BLOND NOBLEMAN
lines_detail.text: And you decided you knew better than every physician in this house?

lines_detail.speaker: JULIANA
lines_detail.text: The physicians were not saving her!

lines_detail.speaker: BLOND NOBLEMAN
lines_detail.text: My aunt has been wasting away for months.

lines_detail.speaker: BLOND NOBLEMAN
lines_detail.text: And now we find an unknown maid alone beside her bed...

lines_detail.speaker: BLOND NOBLEMAN
lines_detail.text: ...holding a substance no one authorized her to give.

lines_detail.speaker: JULIANA
lines_detail.text: Someone has been poisoning Her Grace.

lines_detail.speaker: LADY CATHERINE
lines_detail.text: She admits she has been giving the Duchess poison in secret!

lines_detail.speaker: JULIANA
lines_detail.text: That is not what I said!

lines_detail.speaker: BLOND NOBLEMAN
lines_detail.text: An unknown servant enters a restricted chamber.

lines_detail.speaker: BLOND NOBLEMAN
lines_detail.text: She secretly administers an unidentified substance to a helpless woman.

lines_detail.speaker: CATHERINE
lines_detail.text: She looks exactly like a poisoner.

lines_detail.speaker: JULIANA
lines_detail.text: I did not poison her! Look at her eyes, the fever has broken!

lines_detail.speaker: BLOND NOBLEMAN
lines_detail.text: But the guards know how to extract the truth.

lines_detail.speaker: DOWAGER DUCHESS
lines_detail.text: I know what happened to me!

lines_detail.speaker: JULIANA
lines_detail.text: She's still weak, you cannot leave her like this!

lines_detail.speaker: BLOND NOBLEMAN
lines_detail.text: The poison has clearly damaged her mind.

lines_detail.speaker: CATHERINE
lines_detail.text: How convenient that the only person who can prove the poison exists...

lines_detail.speaker: CATHERINE
lines_detail.text: ...is the maid who claims to have discovered it.

lines_detail.speaker: BLOND NOBLEMAN
lines_detail.text: Take her away before she poisons the rest of this house.

lines_detail.speaker: CATHERINE
lines_detail.text: Where did a gutter rat like you find a silver locket?

lines_detail.speaker: CATHERINE
lines_detail.text: A witch has no need for family heirlooms in the gallows.

lines_detail.speaker: CATHERINE
lines_detail.text: I knew I had seen those eyes before.

lines_detail.speaker: CATHERINE
lines_detail.text: ...the girl thrown out of her own family home.

lines_detail.speaker: CATHERINE
lines_detail.text: The bride who married a penniless war veteran...

lines_detail.speaker: CATHERINE
lines_detail.text: ...because no respectable man would have her.

lines_detail.speaker: JULIANA
lines_detail.text: Do not speak about my husband!

lines_detail.speaker: CATHERINE
lines_detail.text: And look at you now. Scrubbing fireplaces in my house.

lines_detail.speaker: CATHERINE
lines_detail.text: What a magnificent fall, Lady Juliana.

lines_detail.speaker: BLOND NOBLEMAN
lines_detail.text: Drag her to the wet cells beneath the south tower.

lines_detail.speaker: CATHERINE
lines_detail.text: This book of weeds will hang her before the magistrate.

lines_detail.speaker: JULIANA
lines_detail.text: That book is my mother's life's work!

lines_detail.speaker: CATHERINE
lines_detail.text: Then perhaps you can explain every page to the magistrate...

lines_detail.speaker: CATHERINE
lines_detail.text: ...before he sends you to the gallows.

lines_detail.speaker: JULIANA
lines_detail.text: Catherine! Please! That book is my mother's only legacy!

lines_detail.speaker: JULIANA
lines_detail.text: It contains years of her work! Her knowledge! Everything she left me!

lines_detail.speaker: CATHERINE
lines_detail.text: Your mother's little book of weeds?

lines_detail.speaker: CATHERINE
lines_detail.text: You still call this a legacy?

lines_detail.speaker: CATHERINE
lines_detail.text: Roots. Leaves. Powders. Strange mixtures written in a dead woman's hand.

lines_detail.speaker: CATHERINE
lines_detail.text: The magistrate will call it witchcraft.

lines_detail.speaker: JULIANA
lines_detail.text: You know that is a lie!

lines_detail.speaker: CATHERINE
lines_detail.text: I know exactly what I need him to believe.

lines_detail.speaker: CATHERINE
lines_detail.text: And when they find your corpse at the end of the rope...

lines_detail.speaker: CATHERINE
lines_detail.text: ...no one will remember what was written inside.

lines_detail.speaker: JULIANA
lines_detail.text: You are doing this because I saved the Duchess!

lines_detail.speaker: CATHERINE
lines_detail.text: I am doing this because women like you forget their place.

lines_detail.speaker: CATHERINE
lines_detail.text: What exactly do you think a penniless veteran can do against Ashbrook?

lines_detail.speaker: JULIANA
lines_detail.text: I saved her! I healed her!

lines_detail.speaker: JULIANA
lines_detail.text: They took her locket. But they will not take Alexander from me.

lines_detail.speaker: ELDER NOBLEMAN
lines_detail.text: You have a rat in your cellar, Rupert. And the servants are beginning to smell it.

lines_detail.speaker: RUPERT
lines_detail.text: The Ashcroft girl is locked tight. Nobody knows she is down there.

lines_detail.speaker: ELDER NOBLEMAN
lines_detail.text: The kitchen maids are whispering. They see the soup bowls returned unwiped. They see your guards outside the lower grates.

lines_detail.speaker: RUPERT
lines_detail.text: She knows the Duchess was poisoned.

lines_detail.speaker: ELDER NOBLEMAN
lines_detail.text: Then make certain she isn't! A peasant weed, Rupert! You do not store weeds in your cellar, you burn them!

lines_detail.speaker: ELDER NOBLEMAN
lines_detail.text: We give them a reason to condemn her.

lines_detail.speaker: ELDER NOBLEMAN
lines_detail.text: We use the law to destroy her.

lines_detail.speaker: ELDER NOBLEMAN
lines_detail.text: A maid with herbs in her possession, a secret medicine, an unauthorized visit to the Duchess's chamber.

lines_detail.speaker: ELDER NOBLEMAN
lines_detail.text: Give those facts to a magistrate in the right order, and she becomes a poisoner.

lines_detail.speaker: CATHERINE
lines_detail.text: And if she claims she is a healer?

lines_detail.speaker: ELDER NOBLEMAN
lines_detail.text: Do not hide the evidence, manufacture it. Drag her before the magistrate tomorrow, frame the trial, buy the jury, and let the State hang her.

lines_detail.speaker: ELDER NOBLEMAN
lines_detail.text: She is weak, confused. No magistrate will trust a dying woman's accusations against a respected household.

lines_detail.speaker: ELDER NOBLEMAN
lines_detail.text: She goes before the magistrate tomorrow.

lines_detail.speaker: CATHERINE
lines_detail.text: She will hang. A perfect solution. The town will cheer as the witch's disgraced daughter faces the noose.

lines_detail.speaker: RUPERT
lines_detail.text: I will write the arrest warrant myself.

lines_detail.speaker: ELDER NOBLEMAN
lines_detail.text: Tomorrow, she stops being a prisoner. She becomes a witch.

lines_detail.speaker: CATHERINE
lines_detail.text: Chained in a dungeon like a common criminal.

lines_detail.speaker: CATHERINE
lines_detail.text: Because this is what you were always meant to be.

lines_detail.speaker: CATHERINE
lines_detail.text: Your family dressed you like a lady. They educated you. They gave you a respectable name.

lines_detail.speaker: CATHERINE
lines_detail.text: [chuckles] And still you became a disgrace.

lines_detail.speaker: JULIANA
lines_detail.text: I became a disgrace when I refused to become cruel.

lines_detail.speaker: CATHERINE
lines_detail.text: No. You became a disgrace when Gerald left you standing at the altar.

lines_detail.speaker: CATHERINE
lines_detail.text: Everyone saw you. Everyone watched him chose Clarisse.

lines_detail.speaker: CATHERINE
lines_detail.text: And everyone watched you walk away alone.

lines_detail.speaker: JULIANA
lines_detail.text: A man with more honor than the people sitting above this dungeon.

lines_detail.speaker: CATHERINE
lines_detail.text: [laughs] Love? Look where your precious love brought you.

lines_detail.speaker: JULIANA
lines_detail.text: To a place where I can still look you in the eyes.

lines_detail.speaker: CATHERINE
lines_detail.text: You think love makes you better than me?

lines_detail.speaker: JULIANA
lines_detail.text: No. But cruelty certainly doesn't make you better than me.

lines_detail.speaker: CATHERINE
lines_detail.text: I have beauty, money, family, status! What do you have?

lines_detail.speaker: JULIANA
lines_detail.text: Knowledge. Love. And people who need me.

lines_detail.speaker: CATHERINE
lines_detail.text: That is why you were born in the wrong world. Women like me are meant to be admired. Women like you are meant to serve.

lines_detail.speaker: JULIANA
lines_detail.text: Then why are you so desperate to make me kneel?

lines_detail.speaker: JULIANA
lines_detail.text: If you were truly powerful, Catherine, you wouldn't need me to bow.

lines_detail.speaker: CATHERINE
lines_detail.text: This pathetic book is the only thing you still have from your mother.

lines_detail.speaker: CATHERINE
lines_detail.text: There. Finally. Something still hurts you.

lines_detail.speaker: CATHERINE
lines_detail.text: One flame, and your mother's life's work becomes ash.

lines_detail.speaker: CATHERINE
lines_detail.text: You have been so proud of that brave little face...

lines_detail.speaker: JULIANA
lines_detail.text: Burn the ledger. Burn every page.

lines_detail.speaker: JULIANA
lines_detail.text: ...you cannot destroy what my mother taught me.

lines_detail.speaker: CATHERINE
lines_detail.text: You think a few herbs make you better than me?

lines_detail.speaker: JULIANA
lines_detail.text: No. Your cruelty does that for me.

lines_detail.speaker: CATHERINE
lines_detail.text: You still think you are better?!

lines_detail.speaker: JULIANA
lines_detail.text: A woman who survived. You cannot destroy me.

lines_detail.speaker: JULIANA
lines_detail.text: Gerald leaving me was the best thing he ever did for me.

lines_detail.speaker: JULIANA
lines_detail.text: He wanted a woman who looked beautiful beside his wealth.

lines_detail.speaker: JULIANA
lines_detail.text: He wanted a wife whose family could raise his name. He measured a woman's worth by what she could give him.

lines_detail.speaker: JULIANA
lines_detail.text: I was freed. And I found a man who never asked me what I was worth.

lines_detail.speaker: JULIANA
lines_detail.text: Because that nobody showed me more love than your entire world ever did.

lines_detail.speaker: CATHERINE
lines_detail.text: You know nothing about my world.

lines_detail.speaker: JULIANA
lines_detail.text: I know exactly what your world values.

lines_detail.speaker: JULIANA
lines_detail.text: And a woman who never embarrasses the people standing behind her.

lines_detail.speaker: CATHERINE
lines_detail.text: And what is wrong with that?!

lines_detail.speaker: JULIANA
lines_detail.text: Nothing. Until you have nothing left beneath it.

lines_detail.speaker: JULIANA
lines_detail.text: You have spent your whole life collecting things that make people bow...

lines_detail.speaker: JULIANA
lines_detail.text: ...but you have never learned how to make anyone love you.

lines_detail.speaker: JULIANA
lines_detail.text: You want everyone to believe you are powerful.

lines_detail.speaker: JULIANA
lines_detail.text: You want everyone to fear you.

lines_detail.speaker: JULIANA
lines_detail.text: You have to threaten a chained woman to feel powerful!

lines_detail.speaker: JULIANA
lines_detail.text: You may have the title you have always wanted...

lines_detail.speaker: JULIANA
lines_detail.text: ...but you will never have the courage to earn what you demand from everyone else.

lines_detail.speaker: CATHERINE
lines_detail.text: You think you can lecture me?!

lines_detail.speaker: CATHERINE
lines_detail.text: Then let's see how brave you are when it touches your skin!

lines_detail.speaker: LORD
lines_detail.text: That is not what I asked.

lines_detail.speaker: LORD
lines_detail.text: Did she use her mother's book?

lines_detail.speaker: LORD
lines_detail.text: Did she prepare things no physician had prescribed?

lines_detail.speaker: LORD
lines_detail.text: And did she perform anything unusual?

lines_detail.speaker: LORD
lines_detail.text: Your brother is still a pauper.

lines_detail.speaker: LORD
lines_detail.text: One word from me, and the county gaol will take him before sunrise.

lines_detail.speaker: MAID
lines_detail.text: Please, my Lord... he is only seven!

lines_detail.speaker: MAID
lines_detail.text: What do you want me to say?!

lines_detail.speaker: LORD
lines_detail.text: She drew something around the bed, did she not?

lines_detail.speaker: MAID
lines_detail.text: She... placed dried herbs around him.

lines_detail.speaker: LORD
lines_detail.text: And she opened her mother's book...

lines_detail.speaker: LORD
lines_detail.text: ...and spoke words you could not understand.

lines_detail.speaker: LORD
lines_detail.text: You saw a woman draw a circle of herbs.

lines_detail.speaker: LORD
lines_detail.text: You saw her use a forbidden book.

lines_detail.speaker: LORD
lines_detail.text: You heard words you could not understand.

lines_detail.speaker: MAID
lines_detail.text: No! She saved Toby! She made him breathe again!

lines_detail.speaker: MAID
lines_detail.text: I never said she was a witch!

lines_detail.speaker: LORD
lines_detail.text: I have already written the story for you.

lines_detail.speaker: LORD
lines_detail.text: And now... you will save your brother.

lines_detail.speaker: LORD
lines_detail.text: Save your tears for the trial.

lines_detail.speaker: JUDGE
lines_detail.text: Lady Juliana Ashcroft, you are accused of witchcraft, unlawful healing, and poisoning.

lines_detail.speaker: JUDGE
lines_detail.text: Do you deny possessing this book?

lines_detail.speaker: JUDGE
lines_detail.text: Do you deny using its remedies?

lines_detail.speaker: JUDGE
lines_detail.text: Then you admit to practicing forbidden arts.

lines_detail.speaker: LADY JULIANA
lines_detail.text: I admit to healing the sick.

lines_detail.speaker: JUDGE
lines_detail.text: Prudence. You served beside the accused?

lines_detail.speaker: JUDGE
lines_detail.text: Did you witness Lady Juliana perform these treatments?

lines_detail.speaker: PRUDENCE
lines_detail.text: She used herbs... and her mother's book.

lines_detail.speaker: PRUDENCE
lines_detail.text: She... placed herbs around my brother's bed.

lines_detail.speaker: JUDGE
lines_detail.text: And did she speak words you could not understand?

lines_detail.speaker: LORD
lines_detail.text: Your Honor... the witness has confirmed the ritual.

lines_detail.speaker: TOWNSMAN
lines_detail.text: My wife took one of Lady Juliana's mixtures...

lines_detail.speaker: OLD WOMAN
lines_detail.text: My daughter drank one of her herbal preparations! She was sick for three days!

lines_detail.speaker: LADY JULIANA
lines_detail.text: Herbs are not magic! They are medicine!

lines_detail.speaker: JUDGE
lines_detail.text: Without the approval of a licensed physician?

lines_detail.speaker: LADY JULIANA
lines_detail.text: There was no physician willing to help them.

lines_detail.speaker: LORD
lines_detail.text: Even now, she refuses to repent.

lines_detail.speaker: JUDGE
lines_detail.text: Lady Juliana, if you wish to save yourself, renounce these practices.

lines_detail.speaker: JUDGE
lines_detail.text: You understand that refusal may be treated as proof that you knowingly practiced witchcraft?

lines_detail.speaker: LADY JULIANA
lines_detail.text: Do not be afraid. I will not call healing evil just because powerful people have decided to fear it.

lines_detail.speaker: ALEXANDER'S MOTHER
lines_detail.text: I will not die in that house.

lines_detail.speaker: ALEXANDER'S MOTHER
lines_detail.text: They told me you died. They told me your entire regiment was destroyed.

lines_detail.speaker: ALEXANDER
lines_detail.text: Three years ago, I was sent to the Iberian front.

lines_detail.speaker: ALEXANDER
lines_detail.text: It was a classified Crown mission. We were investigating a British officer selling military secrets to French spies.

lines_detail.speaker: ALEXANDER
lines_detail.text: We were close to finding him.

lines_detail.speaker: ALEXANDER
lines_detail.text: I was shot. Left for dead.

lines_detail.speaker: ALEXANDER
lines_detail.text: I crawled away from the battlefield, half dead, alone.

lines_detail.speaker: ALEXANDER
lines_detail.text: I survived because the men who came looking for me believed I was already dead.

lines_detail.speaker: ALEXANDER'S MOTHER
lines_detail.text: Then why did they never tell us?

lines_detail.speaker: ALEXANDER
lines_detail.text: Because someone wanted you to believe I was dead.

lines_detail.speaker: ALEXANDER
lines_detail.text: I spent three years trying to find out.

lines_detail.speaker: ALEXANDER
lines_detail.text: The ambush was not an accident.

lines_detail.speaker: ALEXANDER
lines_detail.text: Someone ordered my men to die.

lines_detail.speaker: ALEXANDER
lines_detail.text: The men behind it... are the same men ruling Ashwood now.

lines_detail.speaker: ALEXANDER'S MOTHER
lines_detail.text: Then why did they never find you?

lines_detail.speaker: ALEXANDER
lines_detail.text: Because they made certain no one would look.

lines_detail.speaker: ALEXANDER
lines_detail.text: My position was leaked to the French... before I could expose what I had discovered.

lines_detail.speaker: ALEXANDER'S MOTHER
lines_detail.text: They gave you to the enemy?

lines_detail.speaker: ALEXANDER
lines_detail.text: They falsified what remained of the reports.

lines_detail.speaker: ALEXANDER
lines_detail.text: While the world mourned a dead heir.

lines_detail.speaker: ALEXANDER
lines_detail.text: They used that trust against you.

lines_detail.speaker: ALEXANDER
lines_detail.text: She went into Ashbourne Manor to save you. She never came back.

lines_detail.speaker: ALEXANDER
lines_detail.text: I thought perhaps she stayed with you.

lines_detail.speaker: ALEXANDER'S MOTHER
lines_detail.text: Rupert and Catherine accused her of poisoning me!

lines_detail.speaker: ALEXANDER'S MOTHER
lines_detail.text: She was taken before a magistrate.

lines_detail.speaker: ALEXANDER
lines_detail.text: They are marrying in two days...

lines_detail.speaker: ALEXANDER'S MOTHER
lines_detail.text: Alexander, you cannot go back there alone!

lines_detail.speaker: ALEXANDER
lines_detail.text: And now they have taken Juliana!

lines_detail.speaker: ALEXANDER
lines_detail.text: Then they have two days to celebrate.

lines_detail.speaker: BLOND NOBLEMAN
lines_detail.text: Every important family in the county should witness it.

lines_detail.speaker: CATHERINE
lines_detail.text: After the ceremony, no one will question who owns this house.

lines_detail.speaker: BLOND NOBLEMAN
lines_detail.text: And no one will question what happened to the woman who tried to stop us.

lines_detail.speaker: CATHERINE
lines_detail.text: Juliana's execution comes after the wedding.

lines_detail.speaker: CATHERINE
lines_detail.text: Perfect timing. It will be a feast for our guests.

lines_detail.speaker: BUTLER
lines_detail.text: Lady Clarissa, an invitation from Ashbridge Manor.

lines_detail.speaker: LADY CLARISSA
lines_detail.text: They want the families to witness it.

lines_detail.speaker: NOBLEMAN
lines_detail.text: A public execution after a wedding.

lines_detail.speaker: LADY CLARISSA
lines_detail.text: Not just an execution. A warning.

lines_detail.speaker: LADY CLARISSA
lines_detail.text: To every woman who thinks she can rise above the place she was given.

lines_detail.speaker: LADY CLARISSA
lines_detail.text: Juliana's ruin will be a lesson. And we will be there to watch.

lines_detail.speaker: JULIANA
lines_detail.text: They think hunger will make me surrender.

lines_detail.speaker: JULIANA
lines_detail.text: They think fear will make me beg.

lines_detail.speaker: JULIANA
lines_detail.text: They can take my name. They can take my home.

lines_detail.speaker: JULIANA
lines_detail.text: They cannot take who I am!

lines_detail.speaker: NOBLEMAN
lines_detail.text: Do you think she'll actually be executed?

lines_detail.speaker: LADY CLARISSA
lines_detail.text: After what she has been accused of? Of course.

lines_detail.speaker: LADY CLARISSA
lines_detail.text: That was her greatest mistake. She could have accepted what happened. She could have disappeared quietly.

lines_detail.speaker: LADY CLARISSA
lines_detail.text: Instead she married a nobody, played healer to peasants, challenged people above her. And now the whole county will watch her pay for it.

lines_detail.speaker: LADY CLARISSA
lines_detail.text: Let them see what happens when a woman forgets her place.

lines_detail.speaker: GUARD
lines_detail.text: Because no one should die hungry.

lines_detail.speaker: JULIANA
lines_detail.text: Do you even know what happened to me?

lines_detail.speaker: JULIANA
lines_detail.text: Do you know they condemned me?

lines_detail.speaker: JULIANA
lines_detail.text: What if I never see you again?

lines_detail.speaker: JULIANA
lines_detail.text: And if I have only one thing left to give...

lines_detail.speaker: JULIANA
lines_detail.text: I will not give them my husband.

lines_detail.speaker: ALEXANDER
lines_detail.text: They buried Alexander Ashwin three years ago.

lines_detail.speaker: ALEXANDER
lines_detail.text: I am taking back my house.

lines_detail.speaker: ALEXANDER
lines_detail.text: And I am bringing my wife home.

lines_detail.speaker: LADY HARRINGTON
lines_detail.text: Look at them. Every noble family in the county is here today.

lines_detail.speaker: LORD HARRINGTON
lines_detail.text: And soon, we'll be connected to the Duchess of Ashburgh.

lines_detail.speaker: LORD HARRINGTON
lines_detail.text: She won't be seeing anything for long.

lines_detail.speaker: LORD HARRINGTON
lines_detail.text: This place has always been unlucky for Juliana.

lines_detail.speaker: LADY HARRINGTON
lines_detail.text: She stands beneath God's watch and still gets exactly what she deserves.

lines_detail.speaker: LADY HARRINGTON
lines_detail.text: And everything that comes after it.

lines_detail.speaker: ELDER NOBLEMAN
lines_detail.text: By sunset, Ashburgh will have its new Duke and Duchess.

lines_detail.speaker: ELDER NOBLEMAN
lines_detail.text: And its witch will be dead.

lines_detail.speaker: BLOND NOBLEMAN
lines_detail.text: You look more queen than bride.

lines_detail.speaker: CATHERINE
lines_detail.text: And you look better in silk than you ever did as an ignored cousin.

lines_detail.speaker: CATHERINE
lines_detail.text: Before I become Duchess of Ashburgh...

lines_detail.speaker: CATHERINE
lines_detail.text: ...I want everyone to see what happens to a woman who dares defy this family.

lines_detail.speaker: NOBLEMAN
lines_detail.text: She actually came back to the chapel.

lines_detail.speaker: NOBLEWOMAN
lines_detail.text: Not as a bride this time.

lines_detail.speaker: CATHERINE
lines_detail.text: This is the world you thought you belonged to.

lines_detail.speaker: CATHERINE
lines_detail.text: And now they can all see what you truly are.

lines_detail.speaker: JULIANA
lines_detail.text: You needed an entire chapel to feel powerful over one chained woman?

lines_detail.speaker: CATHERINE
lines_detail.text: Soon, there will be nothing left between us and the Ashburgh title.

lines_detail.speaker: ROYAL GUARD
lines_detail.text: Because we know who he is.

lines_detail.speaker: BLOND NOBLEMAN
lines_detail.text: You cannot be him. Alexander died!

lines_detail.speaker: ALEXANDER
lines_detail.text: And yet, here I stand. That is the lie you built your life upon.

lines_detail.speaker: ALEXANDER'S MOTHER
lines_detail.text: Look at you... my beautiful boy.

lines_detail.speaker: ALEXANDER'S MOTHER
lines_detail.text: I saw you again... but seeing you like this... I see my son as he was always meant to be.

lines_detail.speaker: ALEXANDER'S MOTHER
lines_detail.text: Let everyone hear me! This is my son... Alexander Ashburn. The rightful Duke of Ashburn!

lines_detail.speaker: ALEXANDER
lines_detail.text: And now, Rupert... we settle what you stole.

lines_detail.speaker: BLOND NOBLEMAN
lines_detail.text: This man is an imposter! Arrest him!

lines_detail.speaker: ALEXANDER
lines_detail.text: These were delivered to me under the seal of the Crown.

lines_detail.speaker: CROWN OFFICIAL
lines_detail.text: Military Intelligence Report, Iberian front, three years ago.

lines_detail.speaker: CROWN OFFICIAL
lines_detail.text: Duke Alexander Ashburn's unit was ambushed after his location was compromised.

lines_detail.speaker: CROWN OFFICIAL
lines_detail.text: The report identifies the leak as deliberate.

lines_detail.speaker: CROWN OFFICIAL
lines_detail.text: Information regarding the Duke's position was transmitted through British channels.

lines_detail.speaker: ALEXANDER
lines_detail.text: You sold my men to the enemy.

lines_detail.speaker: ALEXANDER
lines_detail.text: And when you believed I was dead...

lines_detail.speaker: CROWN OFFICIAL
lines_detail.text: Official death confirmation was filed three months after the ambush.

lines_detail.speaker: CROWN OFFICIAL
lines_detail.text: Duke Alexander Ashburn was declared dead.

lines_detail.speaker: CROWN OFFICIAL
lines_detail.text: His estate and title were subsequently transferred under false authority.

lines_detail.speaker: BLOND NOBLEMAN
lines_detail.text: I was told he was dead!

lines_detail.speaker: ALEXANDER
lines_detail.text: You were told exactly what you needed to hear.

lines_detail.speaker: POLICE CONSTABLE
lines_detail.text: Lord Henry Sterling, you are under arrest by order of the Crown.

lines_detail.speaker: BLOND NOBLEMAN
lines_detail.text: Get your hands off me! Catherine!

lines_detail.speaker: CATHERINE
lines_detail.text: Alexander... I thought you had died.

lines_detail.speaker: CATHERINE
lines_detail.text: Do you know what this did to me?

lines_detail.speaker: CATHERINE
lines_detail.text: For three years, I believed the man I loved was buried somewhere across the sea.

lines_detail.speaker: CATHERINE
lines_detail.text: I was supposed to be your Duchess!

lines_detail.speaker: ALEXANDER
lines_detail.text: You loved the Duke you thought you would marry.

lines_detail.speaker: CATHERINE
lines_detail.text: I loved you before all this!

lines_detail.speaker: ALEXANDER
lines_detail.text: Alexander Ashburton. The rightful Duke of Ashburton.

lines_detail.speaker: ALEXANDER
lines_detail.text: You chose me when you believed I was nobody.

lines_detail.speaker: JULIANA
lines_detail.text: I chose you because you were kind.

lines_detail.speaker: ALEXANDER
lines_detail.text: You chose me when I had nothing.

lines_detail.speaker: JULIANA
lines_detail.text: I chose you because you had honor.

lines_detail.speaker: ALEXANDER
lines_detail.text: And I chose you because you saw the man before the title.

lines_detail.speaker: JULIANA
lines_detail.text: I loved you before I ever knew who you were.

lines_detail.speaker: ALEXANDER
lines_detail.text: And I loved you before I ever dared to tell you.

lines_detail.speaker: ALEXANDER
lines_detail.text: You poisoned my mother. You tortured my wife.

lines_detail.speaker: ALEXANDER
lines_detail.text: You knew exactly what you were doing!

lines_detail.speaker: ALEXANDER
lines_detail.text: You hurt the two women who mattered most to me: my mother, and my wife.

lines_detail.speaker: ALEXANDER
lines_detail.text: Before the Crown and before God...

lines_detail.speaker: ALEXANDER
lines_detail.text: Lady Juliana Ashcroft is my lawful wife... and the Duchess of Ashburton!

lines_detail.speaker: HIGH PRIEST
lines_detail.text: This ceremony was performed without a Crown marriage license, by a priest without authority to sanctify a ducal union.

lines_detail.speaker: HIGH PRIEST
lines_detail.text: These vows were never entered into the Royal Matrimonial Register.

lines_detail.speaker: HIGH PRIEST
lines_detail.text: Before the Crown, you are not Duchess of Ashburton.

lines_detail.speaker: HIGH PRIEST
lines_detail.text: You are not Alexander Ashburton's lawful wife.

lines_detail.speaker: HIGH PRIEST
lines_detail.text: By Royal command, this sanctuary is placed under immediate Crown scesion.

lines_detail.speaker: HIGH PRIEST
lines_detail.text: None shall leave until every witness is accounted for.

lines_detail.speaker: HIGH PRIEST
lines_detail.text: You married this woman as a nameless beggar...

lines_detail.speaker: HIGH PRIEST
lines_detail.text: ...in a hedge ceremony no clerk in England ever recorded.

lines_detail.speaker: HIGH PRIEST
lines_detail.text: Three years later, the beggar is revealed to be a Duke. The marriage does not rise with him.

lines_detail.speaker: ALEXANDER
lines_detail.text: She married the man... not the title.

lines_detail.speaker: HIGH PRIEST
lines_detail.text: The church married a vagrant to a ruined lady. It never married the Duke of Ashburton to anyone.

lines_detail.speaker: HIGH PRIEST
lines_detail.text: No Crown license was sought, because no one thought to ask leave for a Duke to marry.

lines_detail.speaker: HIGH PRIEST
lines_detail.text: ...because a frightened village priest has no authority to bind a peer.

lines_detail.speaker: HIGH PRIEST
lines_detail.text: And no clerk in London ever entered your name in the Royal register, because as far as the Crown knew, Alexander Ashburton was already dead.

lines_detail.speaker: JULIANA
lines_detail.text: I didn't ask this church for permission to survive, Father.

lines_detail.speaker: JULIANA
lines_detail.text: I won't ask it for permission to love.

lines_detail.speaker: HIGH PRIEST
lines_detail.text: Love doesn't make a Duchess, girl. Paper does.

lines_detail.speaker: JULIANA
lines_detail.text: Then look at this floor honestly, for once.

lines_detail.speaker: JULIANA
lines_detail.text: Now a church calls my marriage a lie!

lines_detail.speaker: JULIANA
lines_detail.text: God married us, Father! You are just angry no one asked you first!

lines_detail.speaker: CATHERINE
lines_detail.text: Careful, healer. The floor isn't finished with you.

lines_detail.speaker: HIGH PRIEST
lines_detail.text: Careful, girl. You mistake my patience for weakness.

lines_detail.speaker: HIGH PRIEST
lines_detail.text: God did not marry you. A frightened parishioner did, without leave, without license, without the Crown's blessing!

lines_detail.speaker: HIGH PRIEST
lines_detail.text: And I have the power to undo in one hearing what took you three years to steal!

lines_detail.speaker: ALEXANDER
lines_detail.text: A Duke's marriage is judged by the Crown's peerage court, not by a parish priest's seal.

lines_detail.speaker: HIGH PRIEST
lines_detail.text: The High Religious Council rules on matters of holy matrimony. That includes yours.

lines_detail.speaker: ALEXANDER
lines_detail.text: Then let it prove that in ten days, before witnesses. Not with six halberds pointed at me in my own chapel.

lines_detail.speaker: HIGH PRIEST
lines_detail.text: Ten days. And if the council rules against you, this county watches you lose her twice.

lines_detail.speaker: ALEXANDER
lines_detail.text: I'll take that wager over your decree.

lines_detail.speaker: ALEXANDER
lines_detail.text: Lower them! Or explain to the Crown why its own bailiffs raised iron on the Duke it just confirmed!

lines_detail.speaker: HIGH PRIEST
lines_detail.text: Ten days, Duke. Choose your witnesses well.

lines_detail.speaker: CATHERINE
lines_detail.text: Ten days is plenty of time.

lines_detail.speaker: CATHERINE
lines_detail.text: Rupert is rotting in the undercroft cells. Not me. I intend to stay on this estate.

lines_detail.speaker: CONSPIRATOR
lines_detail.text: Alexander will scour the grounds at first light. The High Council has already blocked the marriage registry.

lines_detail.speaker: CATHERINE
lines_detail.text: Then you will make sure I remain inside these walls.

lines_detail.speaker: CATHERINE
lines_detail.text: Keep the council paralyzed. I will do the rest.

lines_detail.speaker: JULIANA
lines_detail.text: What if Father Thomas sways the High Council?

lines_detail.speaker: JULIANA
lines_detail.text: What if they strip your title? Because of me?

lines_detail.speaker: JULIANA
lines_detail.text: I am only a healer. The lords will never accept me.

lines_detail.speaker: ALEXANDER
lines_detail.text: You saved my mother's life. You stood by me when I had nothing.

lines_detail.speaker: ALEXANDER
lines_detail.text: You were my wife before that priest ever opened his mouth. And we will stand before the King and God again within ten days. Nothing breaks that.

lines_detail.speaker: LADY ASHBOURNE
lines_detail.text: You dare show your face in Ashbourne courtyard?

lines_detail.speaker: CATHERINE
lines_detail.text: I have nowhere to go, Your Grace.

lines_detail.speaker: CATHERINE
lines_detail.text: London closed its doors! My family disowned me!

lines_detail.speaker: LADY ASHBOURNE
lines_detail.text: She aided the poison in my veins. Cast her into the road.

lines_detail.speaker: VAUGHN
lines_detail.text: One command, Your Grace, and I drag her past the gates.

lines_detail.speaker: ALEXANDER
lines_detail.text: Do it, Vaughn! Throw her past the estate perimeter!

lines_detail.speaker: ALEXANDER
lines_detail.text: Juliana, she tried to destroy you!

lines_detail.speaker: JULIANA
lines_detail.text: But Ashbourne does not throw beggars into the mud.

lines_detail.speaker: JULIANA
lines_detail.text: If you seek shelter in this house, Catherine, you earn it.

lines_detail.speaker: CATHERINE
lines_detail.text: You want me? As a guest?

lines_detail.speaker: CATHERINE
lines_detail.text: You expect me to scrub floors before these commoners?

lines_detail.speaker: JULIANA
lines_detail.text: You will scrub the floors you walked on as an impostor.

lines_detail.speaker: JULIANA
lines_detail.text: You will scrub the manor hearths at dawn.

lines_detail.speaker: JULIANA
lines_detail.text: You will scour the kitchen grease until midnight.

lines_detail.speaker: JULIANA
lines_detail.text: One complaint from the housekeeper, and you are cast out with nothing.

lines_detail.speaker: JULIANA
lines_detail.text: I offer you bread and honest labor. Take the apron, or leave the county.

lines_detail.speaker: CATHERINE
lines_detail.text: Two words, and that healer's crown rolls right back into the gutter where it belongs.

lines_detail.speaker: CATHERINE
lines_detail.text: Ten days. He gave himself ten days to fix it.

lines_detail.speaker: CATHERINE
lines_detail.text: Ten days for the council to sit.

lines_detail.speaker: CATHERINE
lines_detail.text: Ten days for witnesses to be gathered.

lines_detail.speaker: CATHERINE
lines_detail.text: Ten days for a decree to be undone.

lines_detail.speaker: CATHERINE
lines_detail.text: Ten days is not a wall, Alexander. It's a door.

lines_detail.speaker: CATHERINE
lines_detail.text: And doors can be closed from the other side.

lines_detail.speaker: AGNES
lines_detail.text: You sent for me, my lady?

lines_detail.speaker: CATHERINE
lines_detail.text: Everyone in that chapel saw me humiliated today.

lines_detail.speaker: CATHERINE
lines_detail.text: Grief makes people careless, and carelessness is exactly what I need from that household right now.

lines_detail.speaker: AGNES
lines_detail.text: My lady... the Duke has bailiffs watching every road out of the county.

lines_detail.speaker: CATHERINE
lines_detail.text: I'm not leaving the county, Agnes. I'm going back into that house.

lines_detail.speaker: CATHERINE
lines_detail.text: Father Thomas did his part beautifully today.

lines_detail.speaker: CATHERINE
lines_detail.text: Now I need him to do a little more before that hearing convenes.

lines_detail.speaker: AGNES
lines_detail.text: If someone sees him come to you...

lines_detail.speaker: CATHERINE
lines_detail.text: That is precisely your job tonight.

lines_detail.speaker: CATHERINE
lines_detail.text: And make sure no one sees him arrive.

lines_detail.speaker: FATHER THOMAS
lines_detail.text: Agnes is thorough. She made me wait for a groom to finish his rounds before she'd let me past the stables.

lines_detail.speaker: CATHERINE
lines_detail.text: Good. That's what I pay her for.

lines_detail.speaker: FATHER THOMAS
lines_detail.text: No shadows tonight, Catherine. Just us and an empty wing.

lines_detail.speaker: CATHERINE
lines_detail.text: You didn't need them the first time, either. I just prefer my secrets thorough.

lines_detail.speaker: FATHER THOMAS
lines_detail.text: A priest and a disgraced bride meeting before dawn in her bedchamber. I'd say thoroughness served us both rather well.

lines_detail.speaker: CATHERINE
lines_detail.text: It will keep serving us as long as neither of us gets careless. No one in this house so much as suspects your face belongs to that morning. Let's keep it that way.

lines_detail.speaker: CATHERINE
lines_detail.text: Today went better than either of us planned for. The whole court watched you humiliate her.

lines_detail.speaker: FATHER THOMAS
lines_detail.text: Fitting choice, this room. A place the family forgot for a conversation they mustn't remember.

lines_detail.speaker: CATHERINE
lines_detail.text: You always did have a taste for symbolism.

lines_detail.speaker: FATHER THOMAS
lines_detail.text: And you always did have a taste for using me. It's why we suit each other.

lines_detail.speaker: CATHERINE
lines_detail.text: Then make certain the council remembers that for the full ten days, not just the first hour.

lines_detail.speaker: FATHER THOMAS
lines_detail.text: What is it you actually need from me, Catherine? Say it plainly, for once.

lines_detail.speaker: CATHERINE
lines_detail.text: First, the hearing stays unresolved as long as possible. Every extension, every delay, every excuse to reconvene.

lines_detail.speaker: CATHERINE
lines_detail.text: Second, I want to know what the council knows before it decides anything. Every argument, every witness, every whisper against her.

lines_detail.speaker: FATHER THOMAS
lines_detail.text: You want eyes inside the council chamber itself?

lines_detail.speaker: CATHERINE
lines_detail.text: I want eyes and ears everywhere that decides my future.

lines_detail.speaker: CATHERINE
lines_detail.text: Is that so unreasonable coming from a woman the church itself just humiliated back into relevance?

lines_detail.speaker: FATHER THOMAS
lines_detail.text: If I keep the hearing open, if I feed you every word spoken behind those doors, what happens to me when the Duke finds out a crowned priest conspired against him?

lines_detail.speaker: CATHERINE
lines_detail.text: Then make certain he doesn't find out. You're careful. I've seen how careful.

lines_detail.speaker: FATHER THOMAS
lines_detail.text: Careful men still hang, my lady, when the crime is treason against a Duke the King himself just restored.

lines_detail.speaker: CATHERINE
lines_detail.text: Careful men who help me also get remembered.

lines_detail.speaker: CATHERINE
lines_detail.text: A grateful Duchess collects debts differently than a desperate one.

lines_detail.speaker: FATHER THOMAS
lines_detail.text: The rest depends on how well you keep your part of this quiet.

lines_detail.speaker: CATHERINE
lines_detail.text: A man in your collar isn't supposed to have that much left in him, Thomas.

lines_detail.speaker: FATHER THOMAS
lines_detail.text: A man in my collar isn't supposed to be in this bed at all.

lines_detail.speaker: CATHERINE
lines_detail.text: Then let's stop pretending this was only appetite.

lines_detail.speaker: FATHER THOMAS
lines_detail.text: The west territory. Tax collection, all of it. Routed through my office.

lines_detail.speaker: CATHERINE
lines_detail.text: That's not absolution, Thomas. That's a fortune.

lines_detail.speaker: FATHER THOMAS
lines_detail.text: Absolution is free. Discretion has a price.

lines_detail.speaker: FATHER THOMAS
lines_detail.text: For as long as it holds.

lines_detail.speaker: CATHERINE
lines_detail.text: Done. You told yourself this ends when the hearing does.

lines_detail.speaker: FATHER THOMAS
lines_detail.text: I've told myself that since the dawn in your bedchamber, and here we are again.

lines_detail.speaker: CATHERINE
lines_detail.text: In another room no one uses?

lines_detail.speaker: FATHER THOMAS
lines_detail.text: Perhaps I like rooms no one uses.

lines_detail.speaker: CATHERINE
lines_detail.text: Or perhaps discretion isn't the only thing you've developed a taste for.
